name: verify_session
description: Verify the caller and bind this call to one worker and case. Must be the first tool called. Read back worker ID, case reference and one-time code before calling.

case_ref.description: Case reference confirmed by read-back, e.g. LAB-1001

worker_id.description: Worker ID confirmed by read-back, e.g. WRK-1001

pin.description: One-time code the caller read out
